spec_match.rationale: Uses the getter-observation technique the dictionary shape exists to enable — was targetAddressSpace read at construction — plus a per-value enum sweep (loopback/local/public/nonsense), with the protocols member as the baseline control.

interactive.rationale: Auto-runs with a rerun button; verified both member probes and the four-value sweep rendered with this build's real outcomes.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The card promises a fact-not-inference detection with no connection or prompt, which the getter probe is.

edge_cases.rationale: Distinguishes 'dictionary not accepted at all' (this build) from 'dictionary accepted but member unknown', and includes the invalid enum value case.

conformance.rationale: The suite's constructor-reads and invalid-value assertions are these probes; on Chromium 141 it honestly ran 2 pass / 3 fail.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp): probes reported neither member read with the '[object Object]' SyntaxError quoted, and the detail correctly concluded this build predates both the options bag and the option; console clean, screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Loads demo-telemetry.js and logs the probe outcomes.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables, verdict banner as text plus colour, captioned tables, no static card.

accessibility.rationale: Verdict and detail are text/aria-live, tables carry captions and scoped headers, rerun button is 44px.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3 (scrollWidth 360, screenshot read).

summary: Reviewed at http://localhost:3000/v154/support-targetaddressspace-option-for-websockets/option-probe/ with Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp). The getter probes ran live and produced the correct pre-154 diagnosis — neither protocols nor targetAddressSpace is read, so the second argument is still a subprotocol list on this build — with the enum sweep's per-value rejections shown honestly. The probe technique itself is the feature's own detectability story, well taught. Console/network clean bar the sandbox font-CDN artifact; no mobile overflow; feature /conformance/ honestly ran 2 pass / 3 fail. Clears the bar.
